text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Whew... That was a fun race. Hmm, hmm... 
Well then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If the clock's hands had moved just a 
little differently, would Maruzen have 
lost at the Arima, I wonder?"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? No, you're wrong!! The one who just 
lost wasn't Maruzen-san, it was me!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I'm not backing down like this! I 
will definitely win next time!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Then at next year's Arima, you'll be zero 
wins and two losses!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Dear me, what a predicament. To think 
you'll be running in the Japan Cup, and 
even CB is entering the Arima Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To ignore the proposal I agonized over 
formulating and simply charge into a match 
following one's own whims…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, as long as it's fun, what's the 
harm!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, no stiff faces for you either, 
Rudolf. Just get swept up in the 
excitement of this match like everyone 
around us.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
To be honest... you got excited, didn't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"See, didn't I tell you? Chiyo-chan has 
such a strong heart and is such a 
fascinating girl!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Still, she has the potential to become 
even more, waaay more wonderful, you know!
